payload.entry: Reviewed bob-mac-capture origin/master at dcbc6b7 after fetch; no commits newer than dcbc6b7. Reviewed a35003a as stash-only and dcbc6b7 as cached-route/task-ID completion integration; no regression or fix needed. Verified git diff --check; bash -n Tests/Fixtures/fake-bob; jq JSON smoke for capture-parse, capture-complete task and later-batch task completion, capture-task-id, and capture; swift build --target CaptureCore; swift build --target CaptureCoreTests. swift test --filter CaptureCoreTests is not locally runnable on Linux because SwiftPM still compiles the AppKit app target. Exact-head CI run 31895172100 https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/31895172100 succeeded for dcbc6b7; macOS 26 job 95037275442 passed formatting, build, tests, bundle, plist/signature verification, launch smoke, and install/reinstall.

Verified owner-assisted signed installed-app matrix for Bob Mac Capture.app at bob-mac-capture commit dcbc6b7 / CI run 31895172100: captured one task and one note; captured same-target and cross-target batches with first- and second-level authored bullets and confirmed final vault blocks plus source order; compared live preview and explicit preview ordering/exact block lines; exercised Control-J on top-level, nested, and both placeholder depths plus Return versus Command-Return; confirmed unique source-order target opening; confirmed full-draft retention on Bob command, capture, and transport failure; verified foreground banner and expanded Notification Center content for rich single and ordered batch results, singular/plural actions, and opening every intended note without duplicates; in a later batch item chose a missing-ID parent task, assigned its ID, previewed and captured, and confirmed the earlier UTF-8 item and separator stayed unchanged, editor focus returned after success, prompt focus remained after failure, and the complete draft was submitted once for preview and once for capture. All listed rows passed; no failures observed.

Verified final bob-cli-t.4.5.3 audit: fetched both repos; bob-cli remains 3beae5b with no commits after 3beae5b; bob-mac-capture was fast-forwarded to origin/master dcbc6b7 with no commits newer than dcbc6b7. Reviewed bob-cli-t.4 children, bob-cli-t.4.5.1/.2 notes, and follow-up outcomes: signed installed-app matrix completed as epic work; bob-cli-y owns the unrelated 57-file prompt migration; transient parent-unpublished warning declined; bob-cli-v and bob-cli-w remain unrelated ready tasks; bob-cli-x is closed done with green CI evidence. Verified bob-cli git diff --check and just all; bob-mac-capture git diff --check, bash -n Tests/Fixtures/fake-bob, later-item fake-Bob parse/complete jq smoke, swift build --target CaptureCore, and swift build --target CaptureCoreTests, with only existing bob-cli-w Sendable warnings. No just symvision recipe exists in bob-cli. Added status: done to plan:202608/land_multi_capture.md; sase plan show resolves it as done and sase plan validate reports 0 warnings. Recorded the final audit on bob-cli-t.4 and did not close the parent epic per launch instruction.
